checks.message: The repository provisional boundary is explicitly disclosed as a low-confidence intake container; it supports concept review but no statutory or engineering claim, and official polygons trigger full-package recomputation.
All three required key areas are present and explicitly provisional; official polygons trigger recropping of all nine layers and regeneration of metrics, figures and PDFs.
The conceptual land-use carrier covers the provisional site without overlap and is labelled non-statutory; FAR, density, height, ownership and development capacity remain unknown.
Static HTML visualization is generated without external dependencies.

The 15 required design-depth responses are structurally complete, but completeness is not represented as field completion. Each key area has a pre-site-fit plan/section prototype with dependency order, unresolved dimension domains, missing data and next-stage scaled deliverables; the package explicitly contains no true site-fitted 1:500 or 1:100–1:200 drawing.
Chinese and English proposals share the required 13-section contract, aligned evidence markers, five localized figures and the same language-neutral concept render.

All 31 assumptions register missing survey, weather, wind, drainage, ownership, statutory-control, model and operating evidence with resolution triggers; no snow-storage capacity, clearance time, wind-speed improvement, icing probability, model performance or cost is claimed.

V1–V3 state that no trained model, site dataset or result exists and specify inputs, human/rule baselines, advisory outputs, human confirmation, false/missed-alert, lead-time, drift and unnecessary-work evaluation, plus stop/exit and non-AI fallback; no model may declare a public route safe or close it.
